newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jet fuel loses ground on Colonial allocations.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jet fuel loses ground on Colonial allocations.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel slumped over one cent a gallon Monday on the Gulf Coast tracking NYMEX futures and news the Colonial Pipeline will allocate orders from Wednesday until the end of November, traders said.
Colonial also said it would accept no more orders on the 29th cycle, which ends late Tuesday, because of a surge of distillate shipping orders.
Differentials on Gulf Coast aviation-grade 54-grade jet eased 0.75 cent to offers of 2.20 cents below the screen, with low sulfur 55-grade slipping to 1.0 cent below.
Diffs on New York Harbor 54-grade eased 0.20 cent, players said, with offers at 1.0 cent over November futures.
-- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
